subject.title: Attach input provenance to sessions_spawn child tasks

question: Should maintainers adopt the linked provenance patch or clear the linked-PR gate and allow a narrow replacement in `openclaw/openclaw`?
rationale: Current main still has the bug, the same-repo PR is closed unmerged, and the issue remains tied to an open cross-repository closing PR plus `clawsweeper:no-new-fix-pr`, so automation should not choose the ownership path silently.

options.title: Adopt or replace in target repo
options.body: Bring the small provenance diff into an open `openclaw/openclaw` PR with focused tests and real behavior proof, either by refreshing the linked work or authorizing a replacement.

options.title: Wait on the fork PR
options.body: Keep the no-new-fix-pr gate until the open fork PR becomes a viable target-repo landing path.

options.title: Reject the direction
options.body: Close the provenance request as not planned, accepting that `sessions_spawn` remains inconsistent with other inter-session paths.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace in target repo
recommendation.body: Bring the small provenance diff into an open `openclaw/openclaw` PR with focused tests and real behavior proof, either by refreshing the linked work or authorizing a replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: The provenance contract and subagent spawn seam history both point to Peter Steinberger as the clearest routing owner for this workflow choice.
